policy: Axis A engine results (W1, W2 from the passage stream) are compared with golden W1/W2 once each engine has drained the topic. Rows are matched on the keys; every other column must be equal. W1's mean and population standard deviation are floats summed in a different order by each engine, so they may differ by at most 1e-6 s; counts, sums, minima and maxima of integer delays are exact. W2 uses the golden headways rule and is exact except ref_headway_s (float_abs).
